text:
alex: Quick bring-up notes for the new mantic-8k-q8 model across regions/GPU types. Ran p50/p95 + throughput sweeps. TL;DR — flashv3 wins for long sequences on H100(L40) but on A100 the Triton vendor kernel still gives better throughput at our typical batch shapes. Proposing a default: flashv3 on H100, Triton on A100, fallback to flashv2 on L4 for short convo workloads. Thoughts?

maria: Can you drop the raw numbers? :eyes:

alex: Sure — paste of the small sweep below (p50/p95 in ms, throughput in tokens/s). Note these are steady-state after 10k warmup tokens.

alex: ```
GPU,region,batch,seq,kernel,p50,p95,throughput_tokens_per_s,notes
H100-us-east,us-east,4,2048,flashv3,48,82,31250,long seq perf win
A100-eu-west,eu-west,4,2048,triton,55,95,29800,better packing on a100
L4-ap-south,ap-south,8,256,flashv2,16,28,12500,cheap small-seq
H100-us-east,us-east,1,8192,flashv3,120,210,8500,high mem but good p95
A100-eu-west,eu-west,1,8192,triton,140,240,7600,tail slightly worse
```

cheng: Were these runs with q8 static quant or q8am? any perf delta?

alex: q8static for the table. We ran q8am microtests: H100 flashv3 saw ~3% throughput uplift vs q8static; A100 had <1% change. But q8am increased memory jitter slightly which impacted cold-start p99 in some runs.

sam: What about microburst / warmup behavior? We saw flashv3 had higher cold tail previously.

alex: Good point. Observed: flashv3 p99 on cold starts (first 3 requests after idle) was ~2.5x baseline on H100 for long seq; after keeping a tiny warm pool (1-2 requests/minute) tail stabilizes. Suggest add hysteresis and a warmup policy when switching to flashv3.

perf-bot: Automated canary run 1758009987 results: flashv3_canary -> p95 -17%, p99 +12% (cold starts), token_cost -8%. See /ci/artifacts/1758009987/logs

maria: So we need a safety net: switch only if steady-state p95 improves AND cold p99 does not regress >10% OR we can mitigate via warmup. Agree?

alex: Yes. Proposed switch gating checklist:
- must have steady-state p95 improvement >=5% over current kernel for target GPU/region/seq shape
- p99 cold-start regression <=10% OR documented warmup strategy that reduces p99 to acceptable level
- quality eval (LLM-evals) pass: top-10 prompt suite no regression in semantic metrics (ROUGE/EM/embedding-sim thresholds)
- cost per token reduction >=3% (optional but preferred)

cheng: How do we encode this in routing config? Can we do per-region per-GPU kernel preferences with rollouts?

alex: Example routing config snippet for the runtime (pseudo-JSON):
```json
{"kernel_routing": [{"gpu_type":"H100","preferred":"flashv3","canary_pct":10},{"gpu_type":"A100","preferred":"triton","canary_pct":5}],"fallback_order":["triton","flashv3","flashv2"],"warmup_policy":{"min_warm_rps":0.5,"keepalive_seconds":60}}
```

sam: Should we also bind this to payload shape classifier? e.g., if seq_len < 512 prefer flashv2 on L4 even if flashv3 marginally better on long seqs.

alex: Yes — add payload-shape rules. Our small scripts already fingerprint payloads by median sequence length and prompt prefix entropy. Example rule: `if seq_median < 512 and median_batch >= 8 -> prefer flashv2/L4`

maria: Ops question — how to surface these switches to Console dashboards so SRE and customers can see kernel-level rollouts?

alex: Console should show per-model per-region kernel split, canary pct, and delta charts (p50/p95/p99 + tokens/s + cost). I'll file a small Console task after we agree.

perf-bot: Note: regression tests flagged one eval failure (prompt set 42) on q8static + flashv3: hallucination increase on numeric-extract tests. tag: eval/regress/1758009999

cheng: That's critical — halt rollout until we investigate. Maybe quantization + kernel interaction causing subtle fp rounding.

alex: Agreed. Action items: 1) pause broad rollout; 2) run targeted evals on the failing prompt set with q8am + flashv3 to see if quant scheme fixes it; 3) run warmup experiment (keepalive_seconds=60) in canary for 48h and re-measure cold p99. I'll take 1+3. @maria please kick off the q8am eval job?

maria: On it. Kicking q8am eval now, will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:

sam: Nice writeup — one more ask: include cost delta per 1M tokens for budgeting. small change there helps finance.

alex: Will add cost column on the next artifact. For now rough numbers: H100 flashv3 -8% token cost vs Triton on same workload; A100 triton ~+2% vs flashv3 (because throughput packing wins).

perf-bot: Canary run summary will be auto-posted to #eng-ml in 2h.

maria: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after q8am eval results.

cheng: +1 — good plan.

alex: Filing final note: kernel decisions must always be gated by quality evals and cold-tail mitigations. Otherwise small perf wins risk user-facing regressions. :white_check_mark:
